title: Pfizer BNT162 COVID-19 Vaccine — Protocol C4591001 (Amendment 20)
description: Pfizer/BioNTech phase 1/2/3 protocol PF-07302048. Tailored to this specific protocol document.

study_title.description: Full study title as printed on the cover.

investigational_product_code.description: Product code of the investigational product (e.g. 'PF-07302048').

protocol_amendment_number.description: Current amendment number as printed on the cover.

sponsor.description: Study sponsor named on the cover.

phase.description: Phase designation from the cover-page design description.

study_design_descriptors.description: Design adjectives from the cover title (e.g. 'placebo-controlled', 'randomized', 'observer-blind', 'dose-finding').

amendment_history.description: Every prior amendment row from the Document History table (version, date, rationale summary).

schedule_of_activities_visits.description: Visit column headers from the Schedule of Activities (SoA) tables — one entry per visit label (e.g. 'Visit 1', 'Visit 404').

primary_endpoints.description: Every primary endpoint listed in the protocol objectives section.

phase1_booster_dose.description: Details of the Phase 1 booster dose described in Amendment 13 / boostability rationale.

study_design_figure_arms_count.description: Number of treatment arms shown in the study design flow figure.

analysis_populations.description: Every analysis population defined in the statistical considerations / analysis populations section.

early_completion_language_added.description: Whether the current amendment adds language pertaining to early completion of the trial (per Document History).

total_prior_amendments_before_current.description: Count of prior amendments listed in the Document History table (everything before the current amendment). Requires scanning the full amendment history.

months_from_amendment_13_to_current_amen.description: Approximate whole months between Amendment 13 and the current amendment, computed from their dates in the Document History table. Requires date arithmetic.

amendment_20_changes_bullet_count.description: Number of bullet-listed changes described for Amendment 20 specifically in the Protocol Amendment Summary of Changes Table. Requires locating and counting bullets in that one row.

phase_1_additional_boost_dose_ug.description: Dose (in micrograms) of the additional Phase 1 boost mentioned for boostability characterization. Requires cross-referencing Amendment 13 language with Section 4 design rationale.

phase_1_booster_window_span_months.description: Width in months of the boostability-dose window (e.g. if 6–12 months, answer is 6). Derived from the phase_1_booster_dose.months_after_primary_series range.

blinding_architecture.description: Blinding architecture as stated in the cover-page design descriptors. Tests extraction of a terminology-specific concept.

sae_collection_window_in_vaccine_naive_t.description: In the SAE-collection language for BNT162b2-naïve participants, the last visit through which SAEs are collected (e.g. 'Visit 404'). Requires reading the adverse events section and locating the specific cutoff.

includes_hiv_specific_assessment_require.description: Whether the protocol explicitly requires recording HIV viral load and CD4 counts for HIV-positive participants. Tests inference from a specialized sub-population clause.

cover_page_header_fields.description: Cover-page header block: product code (e.g. PF-07302048), product name (e.g. 'BNT162 RNA-Based COVID-19 Vaccines'), protocol ID (e.g. C4591001), amendment number, amendment date, sponsor confidentiality label. Tests cover-page dense form region.

document_history_table_rows.description: Every row of the Document History / Amendment Summary of Changes table: amendment version, date, rationale-summary (may be a multi-bullet cell). Tests long multi-row table with narrative cells — high risk of off-by-one row corruption.

schedule_of_activities_phase_1_visit_hea.description: Ordered list of visit-column headers in the Phase 1 Schedule of Activities (SoA) table. The SoA is the canonical complex multi-header table in clinical protocols. Tests reading the full header row in order.

schedule_of_activities_phase_1_row_label.description: Ordered list of row labels (assessments/procedures) in the Phase 1 SoA table. Tests reading the full row-label column.

dose_administration_schedule_phase_1.description: Each row of the Phase 1 dose-administration table: cohort label, dose in µg, number of participants. Tests row binding on a dose-escalation table.
